title: anyhow aborts when the wrapped error type needs a large alignment
body: Bug: an error type declared #[repr(align(64))] makes Error::new(..) followed by downcast_ref::<T>() abort the process, because the error is read through an address that ignores the alignment padding of the wrapped value.

Outcome: downcast_ref returns the wrapped value for a type with alignment 64, and every existing downcast, drop and display behaviour is unchanged. Fix src/error.rs and add a test in tests/test_downcast.rs.
